newsitem.title: BELGIUM: D.Telekom takes stake in satellite service.
newsitem.headline: D.Telekom takes stake in satellite service.

text.p: Deutsche Telekom AG and U.S. company Hughes Network Systems (HNS) have each taken a stake in Luxembourg's recently set-up European Satellite Multimedia Services SA (ESM), Societe Europeenne des Satellites SA (SES) said in a statement.
No financial details nor the size of the stakes were given.
SES, Intel and the Luxembourg PTT telephone company were the initial shareholders in ESM. SES was its majority shareholder, the statement said.
